_meta.what: Curated per-volume carve plan for splitting the multi-work CGPG Migne volume dumps (cogPG.*) into per-work corpus files; consumed by scripts/carve_cgpg_volume.py
_meta.slug_policy: works with a TLG id use the slug the source registry / crosswalk already holds for that id (the canon-derived house naming); a canon-gap TLG id (tlg2866.tlg002, empty canon title) gets a curated slug on the sibling-work pattern, the lettered_subedition_slugs.json precedent. Works without any TLG id get author.title slugs under the repo's established author slugs (theophylactus-achridensis, michael-psellus, symeon-thessalonicensis, leo-vi-sapiens, procopius-rhetoric, photius, oecumenius, ...), minting new author slugs only where none exists (tiberianus, quadratus-apologeta, pantaenus, rhodon, basilius-i-macedo, constantinus-siculus, demetrius-cydones, joannes-diaconus-hadrianopolitanus, esaias-cyprius, hilarion-monachus, theodorus-agallianus, josephus-ii-patriarcha, job-monachus, and the anonymous-work authors laudatio-sancti-demetrii, vita-basilii-iunioris, anonymus-de-vita-mohammedis)
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary goes to exactly one work, normally the later work when the row carries its incipit/heading, the earlier work when the following work's text only starts on the next row; each decision is recorded in the work notes
_meta.rank_rule: a work already served from a better source per the precedence ladder (First1KGreek/Perseus TEI, byzantium.gr manual transcription) is carved to data/corpus_secondary/ with rank secondary, never as a competing primary
